bic.description:
Eight or eleven-digit ISO 9362 Business Identifier Code specifying the Recipient Bank.
This field is optional only when the account number does not have an Iban format.

clearingCodeType.description:
The two-digit code specifying the local clearing network.
If you does not have a bic, this field is required.

clearingCode.description:
The code identifying the branch number on the local clearing network.
If you does not have a bic, this field is required.

street.description: The street and street number for the address described.

postCode.description: The ZIP/Post code for the address described.

city.description: The city for the address described.

province.description: The province code for the address described. This field could be required if the country use a province system, like United States or Canada. To see a full list of province code, please refer to http://www.mapability.com/ei8ic/contest/states.php.

country.description: The two-letters abbreviation for the country, following the ISO-3166 for the address described.
